queue.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 9: AST SpaceMobile Slides on SpaceX Spectrum Move
queue.resumo: AST SpaceMobile (NASDAQ:ASTS), a satellite-based mobile broadband network for standard smartphones, closed at $50.97, down 10.48%. Pressure from SpaceX's spectrum move weighed on shares, while investors are now watching carrier partnerships and commercialization progress.Trading
